Project Overview

Introduction

User Access Control is a web application developed using Python and FastAPI. It provides authentication and authorization functionality to control which pages a logged-in user can access.

The application verifies user credentials during login and uses session-based authentication to maintain the user’s login state.

Objectives

  • Provide secure user authentication.

  • Store user information in a MySQL database.

  • Protect application pages from unauthorized access.

  • Assign different page permissions to different users.

  • Display an access denied page when a user tries to access a restricted page.

Main Features

User Authentication

Users can log in using their username and password. Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes rather than plain text.

Session Management

The application uses Starlette SessionMiddleware to maintain user login sessions.

Page-Level Authorization

Each user is assigned permission to access specific pages. The application checks these permissions before displaying protected pages.

Technology Used

  • Python 3.13

  • FastAPI

  • MySQL

  • PyMySQL

  • Starlette

  • bcrypt

  • HTML

  • CSS

Application Pages

The application includes the following protected pages:

  • Page 1

  • Page 2

  • Page 3

  • Page 4

The pages available to a user depend on the permissions assigned to that user.
